title: Data Recipe Generator
description: A fast Data Recipe generator for Data Pack.
body:
![smithing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/deffee4e7f792bff1a38ebd59d44da3b077840fb.png)
![Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/589a219889e114d872350507a003a5f58bfca91f.png)
Data Recipe Generator

A simple and efficient tool to speed up your mod development workflow by generating recipe JSON files directly from in-game GUIs.

Features:

In-GUI Recipe Generation: Adds a "Generate Recipe" button directly to the vanilla crafting table and smithing table interfaces.
Flexible Naming: Choose from multiple file naming modes, including normal, active (auto-detect item ID), half-active (auto-detect with custom suffix), and upgrade (smithing-specific, e.g., diamond_sword_to_netherite_sword).
Shaped & Shapeless Support: Quickly toggle between shaped and shapeless recipes for the crafting table.
Customizable Path & Namespace: Set your desired output directory and namespace, with caching so you don't have to re-enter them every time.

Print shift to open Gui from Crafting and Smithing Table.

Instant Datapack Output: Recipes are generated directly into your world's datapack folder, ready to use immediately.
